alexcrichton opened PR #14829 from alexcrichton:timeout-moer to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit refactors the default implementation of sending an HTTP request with wasi:http to apply the connect_timeout specified only one time to the entire setup of creating the connection, dealing with TLS, and then establishing the initial HTTP connection. The refactoring here moves all this logic into a single async block to time out, as opposed to timing out individual operations.
